title.value: Back-Training excels Self-Training at Unsupervised Domain Adaptation of Question Generation and Passage Retrieval
title.justification: The title of the paper is clearly stated at the beginning of the document.
title.quote: Back-Training excels Self-Training at Unsupervised Domain Adaptation of Question Generation and Passage Retrieval

analysis.description: This paper introduces back-training, an alternative to self-training, for unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) in question generation and passage retrieval tasks. The authors propose back-training to align natural outputs with noisy inputs, significantly improving model performance over self-training methods. They conducted UDA experiments on datasets from the Natural Questions domain to machine learning and biomedical domains, resulting in substantial improvements in BLEU-4 and retrieval accuracy. The paper also introduces a new dataset called MLQuestions, which facilitates domain adaptation in the machine learning domain.

type.justification: The paper provides empirical results and experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of back-training over self-training in domain adaptation tasks.
type.quote: We run UDA experiments on question generation and passage retrieval from the Natural Questions domain to machine learning and biomedical domains.
